WHAT CHANGED SINCE v59 ON THIS TARGET -- THREE COMPILER FIXES, ALL TARGET-INDEPENDENT
  This target goes straight from v59 to v62, so it takes v60, v61 and v62 at once.
  git diff --stat 5c89c538b8 ade0c47fc4 -- compiler/ is exactly fmodule.pas +32,
  nbas.pas +19, tgobj.pas +15; nothing under rtl/ or packages/ moved.
    407ef9bb3a  GOD   (v60)  tgobj.pas  a freed statement-scoped interface temp is
                re-stamped to the statement that freed it, so the prefix temps of
                "with Make do begin ... end" no longer leak until routine exit.
    2df7b40d2a  Otto  (v61)  nbas.pas   a compiler-built statement list is never
                spliced into a source block.  "with Make.o do begin ... end" (Make
                returns a COM interface, .o the object inside it) released the
                interface BEFORE the body ran whenever the with statement was not
                the first statement of its block -- the body worked on a FREED
                object.  A use-after-free on every target, at -O- and -O2.
    ade0c47fc4  Otto  (v62)  fmodule.pas  a unit compiled FROM SOURCE is recompiled,
                not reloaded, when a unit it resolved symbols out of is reset in
                the middle of a build.  The reload left pointers into the freed
                unit; incremental Lazarus IDE builds died with EAccessViolation
                (exit 217).  Measured on v59, v60 and v61 before the fix.
  COMPILER BINARY ONLY.  No RTL change, no package change, no PPU FORMAT change,
  so the unit set this target already pairs with stays valid.

HOW FAR THE VERIFICATION GOES ON THIS TARGET -- READ THIS BEFORE QUOTING IT
  THIS BINARY HAS NEVER BEEN EXECUTED.  The build host is x86_64-linux, there is
  no macOS on it and nothing here runs a Mach-O.  That was equally true of every
  darwin binary before it; no scheduled queue on this site reaches a Mac.
  What IS established:
    - Format and architecture by file(1) on the exact bytes in this tarball.
    - The patched code was really recompiled: the per-target unit dir was wiped
      first and fmodule, nbas and tgobj were written fresh; the unit COUNT is
      asserted, never the hash.
    - The fixes are compiled in, by a SINGLE-AXIS Mach-O section triage: the v59
      source (5c89c538b8, the three changed files swapped back) and the v62
      source were each cross-built HERE, TODAY, with the SAME driver compiler,
      the same RTL units and the same flags.  The control that makes the delta a
      SOURCE measurement is that the v59 rebuild reproduces the v59 binary
      shipped on 2026-09-17 SECTION FOR SECTION (numbers below).
    - The BEHAVIOUR of this source was proven by EXECUTION on this host for the
      same CPU: the lifetime matrices, the with-prefix matrix and the reload gate
      pass on the Linux compilers built from this commit, and the published v59
      compilers fail the with-prefix matrix (16 FAIL) and the reload gate on the
      same harness.  All three fixes live in CPU- and OS-independent code.
  What is NOT established: that this binary starts, compiles or links on a Mac.
  If you have a macOS box, the one number worth sending back is the exit code
  of the compiler run with -iV (expect 0, printing 3.3.1) -- it needs no SDK and
  no unit set.  An unsigned arm64 binary is KILLED by Apple Silicon macOS
  (Killed: 9) as a policy result, not a compiler verdict; codesign -f -s - it
  and retry.
AD-HOC SIGNING CHANGES THIS HASH -- A MISMATCH IS NOT CORRUPTION
  Every md5/sha256 above describes the binary AS STAGED, UNSIGNED.  Lazarus
  build-release.sh ad-hoc signs every bundled Mach-O with rcodesign and the
  compiler is hard-linked into the .app, so the top-level copy is rewritten too.
  The predicted AS-SHIPPED digests below are a CROSS-CHECK, not the authority:
  build-release.sh's "AS SHIPPED IN THIS TARBALL" stamp wins if they disagree.
  The prediction was validated in the same run against known answers: signing
  the v59 bytes under their shipped names reproduces exactly what the r27
  Lazarus release ships (ppcx64 9393312 / 0ab83bbf196fc6ca8b29cf94231750b0,
  ppca64 7338752 / ab3d20b8ea24b56a291dc23c82510528), and re-signing is a no-op.
  Section triage, x86_64 (x86_64-apple-darwin25.2-size -m):
    v59 shipped 2026-09-17        __TEXT,__text 4384318   __DATA,__const 1581784   9269400 bytes
    v59 source rebuilt today      __TEXT,__text 4384318   __DATA,__const 1581784   9269400 bytes
                                  (differs from the shipped file in 18 bytes: the 16-byte
                                  LC_UUID and 2 digits of the date in the
                                  "FPC Unleashed [yyyy/mm/dd]" banner; every section identical)
    v62 (this binary)             __TEXT,__text 4384590   __DATA,__const 1581784   9269392 bytes
    delta v59 -> v62              __text +272, __const +0: the three fixes.
  Predicted AS-SHIPPED digests, if this binary is signed with no other mutation:

  VERIFY UNDER THE REAL FILENAME OR THE NUMBER IS WRONG: rcodesign takes the
  Mach-O binary identifier from the FILE'S NAME when none is embedded, and that
  identifier is covered by the signature.
